title: Fermi Paradox: The Dyson Dilemma v2.0
summary: Isaac Arthur examines the Dyson Dilemma, the puzzle of why we see no Dyson spheres or megastructures if growth-oriented civilizations should build them. He covers detectability and whether such structures could hide.
why: Recommended in Fermi paradox threads as a thorough and reasoned treatment of Dyson sphere detectability.

quote.text: He describes the Fermi Paradox and related concepts 100x better than anyone else.
